name: Adelaide University Susan Seymour Student Grant
summary: One-off $2,000 grant for commencing undergraduates in any discipline who show financial need or low income.
key: Value: $2,000 (once-off payment after the Semester 1 census date.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen
Financial need or low income, such as a Health Care Card or means-tested Centrelink payment
how: Online application via myScholarships with a written statement of up to 500 words
catches: 2026 applications closed 15 March 2026; check for the next round
